creators.name: Sherwin Bahmani
creators.role_zh: 多伦多大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of 4D-fy, one of the most cited text-to-4D methods of 2023-2024.
creators.bio_zh: 4D-fy 的第一作者，这是 2023—2024 年被引用最多的文本到 4D 方法之一。
creators.why: 4D-fy showed how to combine image, multi-view and video models so that generated 4D scenes look right, hold their shape and move.
creators.why_zh: 4D-fy 展示了如何组合图像、多视角与视频模型，让生成的 4D 场景外观正确、形状稳定且会动。

creators.name: Huan Ling
creators.role: Research scientist, NVIDIA Toronto AI Lab
creators.role_zh: 英伟达多伦多 AI 实验室研究科学家
creators.bio: First author of Align Your Gaussians, NVIDIA's text-to-4D method built on dynamic 3D Gaussians.
creators.bio_zh: 英伟达基于动态三维高斯的文本到 4D 方法 Align Your Gaussians 的第一作者。
creators.why: Moved text-to-4D from slow NeRFs to Gaussian splats that can be composed into longer, multi-object scenes.
creators.why_zh: 把文本到 4D 从缓慢的 NeRF 推进到可组合成更长、多物体场景的高斯泼溅。

creators.name: Tianyuan Zhang
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院 CSAIL 博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of PhysDreamer (ECCV 2024 oral), which gives static 3D objects physical responses learned from video models.
creators.bio_zh: PhysDreamer（ECCV 2024 口头报告）的第一作者，该方法让静态三维物体获得从视频模型中学到的物理响应。
creators.why: Showed that video generators can supply material properties, not only motion, for interactive 3D objects.
creators.why_zh: 证明了视频生成模型不仅能提供运动，还能为可交互的三维物体提供材料属性。

creators.name: Yanqin Jiang
creators.role: PhD researcher, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
creators.role_zh: 中国科学院自动化研究所博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Consistent4D and Animate3D, two early reference points for video-to-4D and for animating existing 3D models.
creators.bio_zh: Consistent4D 与 Animate3D 的第一作者，这两项工作分别是视频到 4D 和为现有三维模型添加动画的早期参照。
creators.why: Animate3D turned 4D generation toward animating 3D assets people already have.
creators.why_zh: Animate3D 把 4D 生成引向为人们已有的三维资产制作动画。

creators.name: Zijie Wu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
creators.role_zh: 华中科技大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of AnimateAnyMesh (ICCV 2025, with Alibaba DAMO Academy) and R-DMesh (SIGGRAPH 2026, with Tencent Hunyuan).
creators.bio_zh: AnimateAnyMesh（ICCV 2025，与阿里巴巴达摩院合作）和 R-DMesh（SIGGRAPH 2026，与腾讯混元合作）的第一作者。
creators.why: AnimateAnyMesh and R-DMesh animate arbitrary meshes from a text prompt or a reference video.
creators.why_zh: AnimateAnyMesh 与 R-DMesh 可根据文字提示或参考视频为任意网格生成动画。

creators.name: Bowen Zhang
creators.role: PhD researcher, University of Science and Technology of China
creators.role_zh: 中国科学技术大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion (ICCV 2025), a video-to-4D diffusion model developed with Microsoft Research Asia.
creators.bio_zh: 与微软亚洲研究院合作的视频到 4D 扩散模型 Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion（ICCV 2025）的第一作者。
creators.why: Trained a diffusion model directly on compressed 4D Gaussian animations instead of distilling video models per object.
creators.why_zh: 直接在压缩后的 4D 高斯动画上训练扩散模型，而不是为每个物体蒸馏视频模型。

creators.name: Remy Sabathier
creators.role: Researcher, Meta and University College London
creators.role_zh: Meta 与伦敦大学学院研究者
creators.bio: First author of ActionMesh (CVPR 2026), Meta's open model that turns a video, an image or text into an animated 3D mesh.
creators.bio_zh: ActionMesh（CVPR 2026）的第一作者，这是 Meta 的开源模型，可将视频、图像或文字变成动画三维网格。
creators.why: ActionMesh made animated-mesh generation fast and topology-consistent enough to drop into standard 3D tools.
creators.why_zh: ActionMesh 让动画网格生成足够快且拓扑一致，可直接导入常规三维软件。

creators.name: Yehonathan Litman
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Lift4D (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026), which lifts monocular videos of deforming objects into complete 4D Gaussians.
creators.bio_zh: Lift4D（SIGGRAPH Asia 2026）的第一作者，该方法把形变物体的单目视频提升为完整的 4D 高斯。
creators.why: Lift4D fills in the parts of a moving object the camera never saw, using single-view 3D and diffusion priors.
creators.why_zh: Lift4D 借助单视角三维与扩散先验，补全运动物体中相机从未拍到的部分。

creators.name: Yudong Jin
creators.role: PhD researcher, Zhejiang University and Robbyant
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学与蚂蚁灵波科技博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of 4DAnyone (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026), which turns a casual phone video of a person into a 4D Gaussian human.
creators.bio_zh: 4DAnyone（SIGGRAPH Asia 2026）的共同第一作者，该方法把一段随手拍的人物视频变成 4D 高斯人体。
creators.why: Brings free-viewpoint people to anyone with a single camera, by generating the missing views.
creators.why_zh: 通过生成缺失的视角，让只有一台相机的人也能得到可自由换视角的人物。

creators.name: Daniel Watson
creators.bio: Co-first author of 4DiM and earlier 3D novel-view diffusion work (3DiM) at Google.
creators.bio_zh: 4DiM 及谷歌早期三维新视角扩散工作 3DiM 的共同第一作者。
creators.why: 4DiM was one of the first diffusion models to take both a camera pose and a timestamp as input for real scenes.
creators.why_zh: 4DiM 是最早同时以相机位姿和时间戳为输入、面向真实场景的扩散模型之一。

creators.name: Wenqiang Sun
creators.role: PhD researcher, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of DimensionX, an open image-to-3D/4D scene method from HKUST and Tsinghua University.
creators.bio_zh: DimensionX 的共同第一作者，这是香港科技大学与清华大学的开源图像到三维 / 4D 场景方法。
creators.why: DimensionX showed that one video model can be steered to vary only space or only time, the two ingredients of 4D.
creators.why_zh: DimensionX 证明可以引导同一个视频模型只改变空间或只改变时间，而这正是 4D 的两个要素。

creators.name: Chaoyang Wang
creators.bio: First author of 4Real-Video and 4Real-Video-V2, Snap's line of 4D video diffusion models.
creators.bio_zh: Snap 4D 视频扩散模型系列 4Real-Video 与 4Real-Video-V2 的第一作者。
creators.why: The 4Real-Video models generate a grid of views over time and lift it into Gaussians in one pass.
creators.why_zh: 4Real-Video 系列生成“视角 × 时间”的画面网格，并一次性提升为高斯。

creators.name: Haoyi Zhu
creators.role_zh: 上海人工智能实验室研究者
creators.bio: First author of Aether, Shanghai AI Lab's open geometry-aware world model.
creators.bio_zh: 上海人工智能实验室开源几何感知世界模型 Aether 的第一作者。
creators.why: Aether ties video prediction to 4D geometry so that a world model's output can be measured in 3D.
creators.why_zh: Aether 把视频预测与 4D 几何绑定，使世界模型的输出可以在三维中度量。

creators.name: Tianqi Liu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and NTU S-Lab
creators.role_zh: 华中科技大学与南洋理工大学 S-Lab 博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Free4D (ICCV 2025) and Light-X, on 4D scene generation and rendering with video models.
creators.bio_zh: Free4D（ICCV 2025）与 Light-X 的第一作者，研究借助视频模型的 4D 场景生成与渲染。
creators.why: Free4D builds a 4D scene from one image without training a new model.
creators.why_zh: Free4D 无需训练新模型，就能从一张图像构建 4D 场景。

creators.name: Zizhang Li
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of WonderPlay (ICCV 2025 Highlight) in Jiajun Wu's group.
creators.bio_zh: 吴佳俊组 WonderPlay（ICCV 2025 Highlight）的共同第一作者。
creators.why: WonderPlay makes generated 3D scenes react to actions such as wind or a push.
creators.why_zh: WonderPlay 让生成的三维场景对风吹、推动等动作作出反应。

creators.name: Yuxue Yang
creators.role: PhD researcher, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and CreateAI
creators.role_zh: 中国科学院自动化研究所与 CreateAI 博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of NeoVerse (CVPR 2026 Highlight), a 4D world model trained on in-the-wild monocular videos.
creators.bio_zh: NeoVerse（CVPR 2026 Highlight）的第一作者，这是一个在真实单目视频上训练的 4D 世界模型。
creators.why: NeoVerse scales 4D world modelling with ordinary videos instead of scarce multi-view 4D captures.
creators.why_zh: NeoVerse 用普通视频而非稀缺的多视角 4D 采集数据来扩展 4D 世界建模。

creators.name: You-Zhe Xie
creators.role: Researcher, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and Alaya Lab
creators.role_zh: 阳明交通大学与 Alaya Lab 研究者
creators.bio: First author of OuroWorld (2026), which turns static 3D Gaussian worlds into looping 3D cinemagraphs.
creators.bio_zh: OuroWorld（2026）的第一作者，该方法把静态三维高斯世界变成循环播放的三维动态照片。
creators.why: OuroWorld adds motion to worlds generated by tools such as Marble, which are otherwise frozen in time.
creators.why_zh: OuroWorld 为 Marble 等工具生成的、原本静止的世界加入运动。

creators.name: InSpatio
creators.role: Chinese spatial-intelligence start-up building 3D and 4D world models
creators.role_zh: 构建三维与 4D 世界模型的中国空间智能初创公司
creators.bio: Company whose INSPATIO-WORLD paper is co-authored with Zhejiang University 3D-vision researchers (Guofeng Zhang, Hujun Bao); it releases open models such as InSpatio-World, InSpatio-WorldFM and QuerySplat.
creators.bio_zh: 其 INSPATIO-WORLD 论文与浙江大学三维视觉研究者（章国锋、鲍虎军）合著；公司发布了 InSpatio-World、InSpatio-WorldFM、QuerySplat 等开源模型。
creators.why: Its open InSpatio-World turns a single video into a dynamic scene that can be explored in real time.
creators.why_zh: 其开源的 InSpatio-World 能把单段视频变成可实时探索的动态场景。

creators.name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
creators.role: Public AI research institute in Shanghai
creators.role_zh: 位于上海的公共人工智能研究机构
creators.bio: Large state-backed research institute (also known as PJLab) working on foundation models, embodied AI and 3D vision; home of the π³ reconstruction model.
creators.bio_zh: 大型公共科研机构（又称浦江实验室），研究基础模型、具身智能与三维视觉，π³ 重建模型出自这里。
creators.why: One of the Chinese labs whose open 3D geometry models are widely used as reconstruction backbones.
creators.why_zh: 其开源三维几何模型被广泛用作重建骨干网络，是这一方向的重要中国实验室之一。

works.title: 4D-fy
works.description: 4D-fy generates a short animated 3D scene, such as a bear driving a car, from a text prompt; the result can be watched from any angle while it moves.
works.description_zh: 4D-fy 能根据一句文字提示生成一段会动的三维场景（例如一只开车的熊），在播放时可以从任意角度观看。
works.idea_en: Text-to-4D needs several teachers at once: image models for appearance, multi-view models for shape and video models for motion.
works.idea_zh: 文本到 4D 需要同时向多个“老师”学习：图像模型管外观，多视角模型管形状，视频模型管运动。
works.method: A 4D radiance field built on multi-resolution hash encodings is optimised per prompt with hybrid score distillation, which alternates gradients from a text-to-image, a 3D-aware multi-view and a text-to-video diffusion model.
works.method_zh: 以多分辨率哈希编码的 4D 辐射场为表示，针对每个提示用“混合分数蒸馏”优化，交替使用文生图、三维感知多视角与文生视频扩散模型的梯度。

paper.title: 4D-fy: Text-to-4D Generation Using Hybrid Score Distillation Sampling

works.title: Align Your Gaussians (AYG)
works.description: NVIDIA's Align Your Gaussians turns a text prompt into an animated 3D object made of moving Gaussians, and can chain and combine several such animations into longer scenes with more than one actor.
works.description_zh: 英伟达的 Align Your Gaussians 把文字提示变成由运动高斯组成的动画三维物体，还能把多段动画串联、组合成包含多个角色的更长场景。
works.idea_en: Gaussian 4D content can be composed like clips: separately generated moving objects can be placed together in one scene.
works.idea_zh: 高斯表示的 4D 内容可以像片段一样组合：分别生成的运动物体可以放进同一个场景。
works.method: Dynamic 3D Gaussians with deformation fields are optimised by composed score distillation from a text-to-image, a multi-view and a text-to-video model (VideoLDM), with a regulariser on Gaussian motion and autoregressive extension for longer sequences.
works.method_zh: 以带形变场的动态三维高斯为表示，用文生图、多视角与文生视频模型（VideoLDM）的组合分数蒸馏进行优化，对高斯运动加入正则，并以自回归方式延长序列。

paper.title: Align Your Gaussians: Text-to-4D with Dynamic 3D Gaussians and Composed Diffusion Models

works.title: PhysDreamer
works.description: PhysDreamer makes a captured 3D object, such as a flower or a plant, respond physically when it is poked or pulled: it sways, bends and springs back with dynamics learned from a video generator.
works.description_zh: PhysDreamer 让一个捕捉得到的三维物体（例如花或盆栽）在被戳、被拉时作出物理响应：它会摇摆、弯曲再弹回，这种动态是从视频生成模型中学来的。
works.idea_en: Uses a video model as a source of physical properties, so generated motion is a consequence of a person's action rather than a fixed clip.
works.idea_zh: 把视频模型当作物理属性的来源，使生成的运动成为人的动作的后果，而不是一段固定的片段。
works.method: A video generation model animates a rendered view of a static 3D Gaussian object; a spatially varying material field (Young's modulus) is optimised so that a differentiable material point method (MPM) simulation matches that video, after which new forces can be simulated; realism was rated in a user study.
works.method_zh: 先用视频生成模型让静态三维高斯物体的渲染图动起来，再优化空间变化的材料场（杨氏模量），使可微物质点法（MPM）仿真与该视频一致，之后即可仿真新的外力；真实感通过用户研究评估。

paper.title: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation

works.title: Animate3D
works.description: Animate3D takes an existing static 3D model and a text prompt and makes the model move, keeping its look and shape consistent from every viewing angle.
works.description_zh: Animate3D 以现有的静态三维模型和一句文字提示为输入，让模型动起来，并在各个视角下保持外观与形状一致。
works.idea_en: 4D generation as an animation pass on assets that already exist, rather than generating new objects from scratch.
works.idea_zh: 把 4D 生成当作给现有资产添加动画的一道工序，而不是从零生成新物体。
works.method: A multi-view video diffusion model (MV-VDM), conditioned on multi-view renderings of the static object and trained on a new multi-view video dataset (MV-Video), generates consistent motion; motion is first reconstructed from these videos and then refined with 4D score distillation.
works.method_zh: 以静态物体的多视角渲染为条件、在新建的多视角视频数据集 MV-Video 上训练的多视角视频扩散模型（MV-VDM）生成一致的运动；先从这些视频中重建运动，再用 4D 分数蒸馏细化。

paper.title: Animate3D: Animating Any 3D Model with Multi-view Video Diffusion

works.title: AnimateAnyMesh
works.description: AnimateAnyMesh animates any 3D mesh from a text prompt in a few seconds, for example making a dragon flap its wings, without rigging and without per-object optimisation.
works.description_zh: AnimateAnyMesh 能在几秒内根据文字提示为任意三维网格生成动画（例如让一条龙扇动翅膀），无需绑定骨骼，也无需逐物体优化。
works.idea_en: Mesh animation becomes a prompt-and-wait step of seconds, so animated props inside a generated scene are cheap to vary.
works.idea_zh: 网格动画变成“输入提示、等几秒”的一步，让生成场景中的动态道具可以低成本地变换。
works.method: A DyMeshVAE compresses dynamic mesh sequences into latent trajectories while keeping local topology, and a rectified-flow model generates these latents from text; training uses the DyMesh dataset, which the authors report holds over 4 million text-annotated dynamic mesh sequences.
works.method_zh: DyMeshVAE 把动态网格序列压缩为潜在轨迹并保留局部拓扑，再由整流流模型根据文字生成这些潜变量；训练数据为 DyMesh 数据集，作者称其包含 400 多万条带文字标注的动态网格序列。
works.specs: a few seconds per animation (developer claim) · arbitrary mesh topology

paper.title: AnimateAnyMesh: A Feed-Forward 4D Foundation Model for Text-Driven Universal Mesh Animation

works.title: Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion (GVFDiffusion)
works.description: Turns a single video of a moving object, such as a running character, into an animated 3D Gaussian object that can be viewed from all sides; it can also animate an existing 3D model to follow a video.
works.description_zh: 把一段物体运动的单目视频（例如一个奔跑的角色）变成可从各个方向观看的动画三维高斯物体；也能按照视频为现有三维模型添加动画。
works.idea_en: A native 4D diffusion model: generation happens in a compressed space of 3D Gaussian animations instead of distilling a video model for each object.
works.idea_zh: 原生 4D 扩散模型：生成发生在压缩后的三维高斯动画空间中，而不是为每个物体蒸馏视频模型。
works.method: A 4DMesh-to-GS Variation Field VAE encodes canonical Gaussians and their per-frame variations from animated Objaverse objects into a compact latent, and a temporal diffusion transformer conditioned on the input video and canonical Gaussians generates these latents.
works.method_zh: 4DMesh-to-GS 变化场 VAE 把 Objaverse 动画物体的规范高斯及其逐帧变化编码为紧凑潜变量，再由以输入视频和规范高斯为条件的时序扩散 Transformer 生成这些潜变量。

paper.title: Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion for High-fidelity Video-to-4D Synthesis

works.title: ActionMesh
works.description: Meta's ActionMesh turns a short video, an image or a text prompt (or a 3D mesh plus a text description of its motion) into an animated 3D mesh with fixed topology that can be textured, retargeted and imported into standard 3D software. Code, weights and a Hugging Face demo are public under Meta's licence.
works.description_zh: Meta 的 ActionMesh 能把一段短视频、一张图像或一句文字（也可以是一个三维网格加一句动作描述）变成拓扑固定的动画三维网格，可以贴图、重定向并导入常规三维软件。代码、权重和 Hugging Face 演示均以 Meta 的许可证公开。
works.idea_en: Generated 4D arrives as an ordinary animated mesh in about a minute, the format game engines and XR tools already use.
works.idea_zh: 生成的 4D 结果以普通动画网格的形式在大约一分钟内交付，正是游戏引擎与 XR 工具早已在用的格式。
works.method: Temporal 3D diffusion: an existing 3D diffusion model gains a time axis to generate synchronised latents of per-frame shapes, and a temporal 3D autoencoder converts them into deformations of one reference mesh, giving a rig-free, topology-consistent animation.
works.method_zh: “时序三维扩散”：在现有三维扩散模型上加入时间轴，生成逐帧形状的同步潜变量，再由时序三维自编码器把它们转换为同一参考网格的形变，得到无需骨骼、拓扑一致的动画。
works.specs: ≈45–75 s per animation on one H100 (developer figures) · 12 GB VRAM low-RAM mode · ActionBench: 128 video–animated point-cloud pairs

paper.title: ActionMesh: Animated 3D Mesh Generation with Temporal 3D Diffusion

works.title: R-DMesh
works.description: Tencent Hunyuan's R-DMesh animates a user's static 3D mesh so that it follows the motion in a reference video, even when the mesh starts in a different pose from the first video frame. Code and weights were released in May 2026.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元的 R-DMesh 能让用户提供的静态三维网格跟随参考视频中的动作运动，即使网格的初始姿态与视频首帧不一致也能对齐。代码与权重已于 2026 年 5 月发布。
works.idea_en: Video becomes a motion-control handle for any 3D asset: film or generate the movement, then transfer it to the mesh.
works.idea_zh: 视频成为任意三维资产的动作控制手柄：先拍摄或生成动作，再迁移到网格上。
works.method: A VAE splits the input into a base mesh, relative motion trajectories and a learned rectification offset that first moves the mesh into the video's starting pose; a rectified-flow diffusion transformer conditioned on pretrained video latents generates the motion, trained on Video-RDMesh (over 500k dynamic mesh sequences).
works.method_zh: VAE 把输入分解为基础网格、相对运动轨迹以及一个学习得到的“校正跳变”偏移，先把网格移到视频的起始姿态；再由以预训练视频潜变量为条件的整流流扩散 Transformer 生成运动，训练数据为包含 50 多万条动态网格序列的 Video-RDMesh。

paper.title: R-DMesh: Video-Guided 3D Animation via Rectified Dynamic Mesh Flow

works.title: Lift4D
works.description: Lift4D turns a casual monocular video of a deforming animal or object into a complete moving 3D Gaussian model, filling in the sides the camera never saw.
works.description_zh: Lift4D 把一段随手拍摄的形变动物或物体单目视频变成完整的运动三维高斯模型，并补全相机从未拍到的那一侧。
works.idea_en: Generative priors close the gap between what one camera saw and a full 4D object, the step needed to bring real moving things into a 3D scene.
works.idea_zh: 生成式先验弥补了单个相机所见与完整 4D 物体之间的差距，这是把真实运动物体带进三维场景所需的一步。
works.method: A single-view 3D reconstruction model is adapted with causal latent conditioning to give temporally consistent per-frame shapes that initialise deformable 3D Gaussians, which are refined against the video by occlusion-aware optimisation with a view-conditioned diffusion prior for unseen regions.
works.method_zh: 通过因果潜变量条件改造单视角三维重建模型，得到时间上一致的逐帧形状，用来初始化可形变三维高斯；再在遮挡感知的优化中对照视频细化，并用视角条件扩散先验补全未见区域。

paper.title: Lift4D: Harmonizing Single-View 3D Estimation for 4D Reconstruction In-the-Wild

works.title: 4DAnyone
works.description: 4DAnyone turns a casual monocular video of a person, with no calibration or rig, into a 4D Gaussian human that can be replayed from any viewpoint. Code and model are open (Apache-2.0).
works.description_zh: 4DAnyone 能把一段随手拍摄的人物单目视频（无需标定、无需绑定骨骼）变成可从任意视角回放的 4D 高斯人体。代码与模型以 Apache-2.0 开源。
works.idea_en: Free-viewpoint people from one camera: the missing views are generated rather than captured, removing the multi-camera stage of volumetric video.
works.idea_zh: 一台相机即可得到可自由换视角的人物：缺失的视角靠生成而非拍摄，省去了体积视频的多机位采集环节。
works.method: A camera-controlled video diffusion model generates tens of consistent novel-view videos, using Reference Context Packing (a fixed-length reference context) and Target Context Routing (rotating view groups during denoising), and the views are fitted with 4D Gaussian splatting; training mixes a game-engine dataset (MVGameHuman), light-stage and in-the-wild videos.
works.method_zh: 相机可控的视频扩散模型生成数十路一致的新视角视频，采用“参考上下文打包”（固定长度的参考上下文）与“目标上下文路由”（去噪过程中轮换视角分组），再用 4D 高斯泼溅拟合；训练数据混合了游戏引擎数据集 MVGameHuman、光场舞台数据与真实视频。

paper.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video

works.title: 4DiM
works.description: Google DeepMind's 4DiM generates new views of a real scene from one or a few photos at any requested camera position and moment in time, for example moving the camera through a room or re-angling a video.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 的 4DiM 能根据一张或几张照片，在任意指定的相机位置与时间点生成真实场景的新视角画面，例如让相机在房间中移动，或为一段视频换一个角度。
works.idea_en: Treats camera pose and time as two separate controls of one diffusion model, the basic interface later 4D scene generators adopted.
works.idea_zh: 把相机位姿与时间作为同一扩散模型的两个独立控制量，这正是后来的 4D 场景生成器采用的基本接口。
works.method: A cascaded diffusion model conditioned on input images, camera poses and timestamps is trained jointly on posed 3D data, posed video (4D) and unposed video, with structure-from-motion poses calibrated to metric scale using monocular depth.
works.method_zh: 级联扩散模型以输入图像、相机位姿和时间戳为条件，在带位姿的三维数据、带位姿的视频（4D）与无位姿视频上联合训练，并用单目度量深度把运动恢复结构得到的位姿校准到真实尺度。

paper.title: Controlling Space and Time with Diffusion Models

works.title: DimensionX
works.description: DimensionX turns a single photo into either a 3D scene (the camera moves, time stands still) or a 4D scene (time moves and can be viewed from several angles), reconstructed as Gaussian splats.
works.description_zh: DimensionX 能把一张照片变成三维场景（相机移动、时间静止）或 4D 场景（时间流动、可从多个角度观看），并重建为高斯泼溅。
works.idea_en: Separating 'move the camera' from 'let time pass' inside one video model gives a cheap route from any image to a 3D or 4D scene.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个视频模型中把“移动相机”与“让时间流逝”分开，就能以较低成本把任意图像变成三维或 4D 场景。
works.method: ST-Director trains dimension-aware LoRAs on the CogVideoX-5B image-to-video model to control spatial and temporal change separately; the generated view sets are then reconstructed into 3D or 4D Gaussians.
works.method_zh: ST-Director 在 CogVideoX-5B 图生视频模型上训练维度感知的 LoRA，分别控制空间与时间变化；生成的视角集合再被重建为三维或 4D 高斯。

paper.title: DimensionX: Create Any 3D and 4D Scenes from a Single Image with Controllable Video Diffusion

works.title: CityDreamer4D
works.description: CityDreamer4D generates unbounded 4D cities, with buildings, roads and moving traffic, that a camera can fly through while the vehicles drive.
works.description_zh: CityDreamer4D 能生成无边界的 4D 城市，包含建筑、道路与行驶中的车流，相机可以在车辆行驶时于其中飞行穿梭。
works.idea_en: Splits a city into a static background and dynamic actors, so traffic can change while the place stays the same: a template for street-scale generated situations.
works.idea_zh: 把城市拆分为静态背景与动态参与者，使车流可以变化而地点保持不变，为街道尺度的生成情境提供了模板。
works.method: Compositional neural fields: separate generators for buildings, roads and background and for vehicle instances, driven by a bird's-eye-view layout and a traffic scenario, trained on OpenStreetMap, Google Earth and the CityTopia dataset.
works.method_zh: 组合式神经场：建筑、道路、背景与车辆实例各有生成器，由鸟瞰布局与交通场景驱动，在 OpenStreetMap、Google Earth 与 CityTopia 数据集上训练。

paper.title: Compositional Generative Model of Unbounded 4D Cities

works.title: Aether
works.description: Shanghai AI Lab's Aether is an open world model that reconstructs a video as moving 3D geometry with camera paths, predicts future video from an image and a camera trajectory, and plans a path between a start and a goal image.
works.description_zh: 上海人工智能实验室的 Aether 是一个开源世界模型：能把视频重建为带相机轨迹的运动三维几何，根据图像与相机轨迹预测未来视频，并在起始图像与目标图像之间规划路径。
works.idea_en: A world model whose predictions come with 4D geometry, so what it imagines can be checked and measured in 3D rather than judged as pixels.
works.idea_zh: 一个预测结果自带 4D 几何的世界模型，它“想象”出的内容可以在三维中检查和度量，而不只是看像素。
works.method: A video diffusion model (CogVideoX) is post-trained to output video, depth and camera raymaps jointly for reconstruction, action-conditioned prediction and goal-conditioned planning, using only synthetic 4D data; the authors report zero-shot transfer to real videos.
works.method_zh: 对视频扩散模型（CogVideoX）进行后训练，使其联合输出视频、深度与相机射线图，用于重建、动作条件预测与目标条件规划；只使用合成 4D 数据，作者称可零样本迁移到真实视频。

paper.title: Aether: Geometric-Aware Unified World Modeling

works.title: Free4D
works.description: Free4D builds a 4D Gaussian scene from a single image or a text prompt, so a still scene comes alive and can be explored from new viewpoints while it moves, without training a dedicated model.
works.description_zh: Free4D 能从一张图像或一句文字构建 4D 高斯场景，让静态画面动起来，并可在运动过程中从新视角探索，且无需训练专门模型。
works.idea_en: Distils existing image-to-video and multi-view models into a consistent 4D scene, so scene-level 4D does not have to wait for large 4D training sets.
works.idea_zh: 把现有的图生视频与多视角模型蒸馏成一致的 4D 场景，使场景级 4D 不必等待大规模 4D 训练数据。
works.method: The image is animated with an image-to-video model and a coarse 4D structure is initialised; consistent multi-view videos are generated with adaptive guidance and latent replacement, and a 4D Gaussian representation is optimised with modulation-based refinement.
works.method_zh: 先用图生视频模型让图像动起来并初始化粗略的 4D 结构；再通过自适应引导与潜变量替换生成一致的多视角视频，最后以基于调制的细化优化 4D 高斯表示。

paper.title: Free4D: Tuning-free 4D Scene Generation with Spatial-Temporal Consistency

works.title: WonderPlay
works.description: WonderPlay turns a single image into a 3D scene that reacts to actions: a person can add wind, push a glass or pour honey, and the scene's cloth, liquid, smoke or rigid objects move in response.
works.description_zh: WonderPlay 能把一张图像变成会对动作作出反应的三维场景：人可以加一阵风、推一下玻璃杯或倒入蜂蜜，场景中的布料、液体、烟雾或刚体随之运动。
works.idea_en: Couples a physics solver with a video generator so that generated 3D scenes have consequences, not only motion: closer to a situation than a clip.
works.idea_zh: 把物理求解器与视频生成器结合，让生成的三维场景有“后果”而不只是运动，更接近一个情境而非一段片段。
works.method: A hybrid generative simulator: a physics solver predicts coarse 3D dynamics for the input action, these condition a video generator that produces realistic motion, and the generated video updates the dynamic 3D scene in a loop.
works.method_zh: 混合生成式模拟器：物理求解器针对输入动作预测粗略的三维动态，以此为条件让视频生成器生成真实运动，再用生成的视频循环更新动态三维场景。

paper.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions

works.title: 4Real-Video-V2
works.description: Snap Research's 4Real-Video-V2 generates a moving scene from a text prompt (or animates a captured 3D scene or asset) as a grid of videos over viewpoints and time, and lifts every time step into 3D Gaussians in a feed-forward pass.
works.description_zh: Snap Research 的 4Real-Video-V2 能根据文字提示生成运动场景（也可为捕捉的三维场景或资产添加动画），输出“视角 × 时间”的视频网格，并通过一次前向把每个时间步提升为三维高斯。
works.idea_en: Successor to 4Real (2024) and 4Real-Video (CVPR 2025): 4D scene generation without per-scene optimisation, from prompt to dynamic Gaussians.
works.idea_zh: 4Real（2024）与 4Real-Video（CVPR 2025）的后续：无需逐场景优化的 4D 场景生成，从提示直接得到动态高斯。
works.method: A 4D video diffusion model with fused view-time sparse attention (tokens attend within the same frame, timestamp or viewpoint, adding no parameters to the base video model) generates the grid, and a feed-forward reconstruction model with a Gaussian head recovers cameras and per-frame Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 4D 视频扩散模型采用融合的视角—时间稀疏注意力（token 只关注同一帧、同一时刻或同一视角的 token，不给基础视频模型增加参数）生成网格，再由带高斯头的前馈重建模型恢复相机与逐帧高斯。

paper.title: 4Real-Video-V2: Fused View-Time Attention and Feedforward Reconstruction for 4D Scene Generation

works.title: NeoVerse
works.description: NeoVerse reconstructs an ordinary monocular video as a moving 4D scene and generates new videos of it along camera paths the original never took, such as bullet-time shots. Code and weights are open (Apache-2.0).
works.description_zh: NeoVerse 能把一段普通单目视频重建为运动的 4D 场景，并沿原视频从未走过的相机路径生成新视频，例如子弹时间镜头。代码与权重以 Apache-2.0 开源。
works.idea_en: Training 4D world models on everyday monocular videos rather than rare multi-view captures widens the range of scenes they can handle.
works.idea_zh: 用日常单目视频而非稀缺的多视角采集数据训练 4D 世界模型，扩大了它能处理的场景范围。
works.method: Pose-free feed-forward 4D reconstruction of the input video is rendered along a new trajectory, and a video diffusion model trained with online simulation of monocular degradation patterns turns these renders into clean novel-trajectory video.
works.method_zh: 先对输入视频进行无需位姿的前馈式 4D 重建并沿新轨迹渲染，再由训练时在线模拟单目退化模式的视频扩散模型把渲染结果变成干净的新轨迹视频。

paper.title: NeoVerse: Enhancing 4D World Model with in-the-wild Monocular Videos

works.title: InSpatio-World
works.description: InSpatio-World turns a single reference video into a dynamic scene a person can move through in real time, pausing, slowing or reversing time while changing the viewpoint. 1.3B weights (Apache-2.0) and a browser demo are public.
works.description_zh: InSpatio-World 能把单段参考视频变成可实时漫游的动态场景：人可以一边改变视角，一边暂停、放慢或倒放时间。1.3B 权重（Apache-2.0）与网页演示均已公开。
works.idea_en: Real-time 4D from footage: a recorded event becomes a place you can re-enter and view from new positions, while generation stays anchored to the source video.
works.idea_zh: 从视频素材实时得到 4D：一次被录下的事件变成可以重新进入、从新位置观看的地方，同时生成始终锚定原视频。
works.method: A spatiotemporal autoregressive (STAR) video model built on Wan2.1 is conditioned on depth-based point-cloud renders of the reference video along the user's path, keeps an implicit spatiotemporal cache of reference and past frames, and is distilled for real-time use with joint distribution matching distillation (JDMD).
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan2.1 的时空自回归（STAR）视频模型以参考视频沿用户路径渲染的深度点云为条件，维护参考帧与历史帧的隐式时空缓存，并通过联合分布匹配蒸馏（JDMD）实现实时生成。
works.specs: 1.3B open weights · real-time navigation · first among real-time methods on WorldScore-Dynamic (developer claim)

paper.title: INSPATIO-WORLD: A Real-Time 4D World Simulator via Spatiotemporal Autoregressive Modeling

works.title: OuroWorld
works.description: OuroWorld takes a static 3D Gaussian world, for example one generated with Marble or Lyra 2.0, and makes it move as an endlessly looping 3D cinemagraph: water flows, plants sway and lights change, viewable from any position.
works.description_zh: OuroWorld 以一个静态三维高斯世界（例如由 Marble 或 Lyra 2.0 生成的世界）为输入，让它变成无限循环的三维动态照片：水流动、植物摇曳、光线变化，可从任意位置观看。
works.idea_en: A cheap way to bring frozen generated worlds to life: ambient motion that loops without seams gives a place time without needing a full world model.
works.idea_zh: 让静止的生成世界“活”起来的低成本办法：无缝循环的环境运动给场景加入时间，而不需要完整的世界模型。
works.method: A vision-language model proposes plausible dynamics and guides a video model to generate a reference video, which is lifted and completed into multi-view videos; an inconsistency-robust periodic 4D Gaussian model with a Fourier-series deformation field (looping by construction) and a drift field anchored to the reference view is fitted to them.
works.method_zh: 视觉语言模型推断合理的动态并引导视频模型生成参考视频，再提升并补全为多视角视频；随后拟合一个对不一致具有鲁棒性的周期性 4D 高斯模型，其傅里叶级数形变场保证循环，锚定参考视角的漂移场吸收视角间的不一致。

paper.title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs

leads.why: 4D-aware multi-view video diffusion for objects (118 and 122 citations); left out to keep one 2024 multi-view-video step (Animate3D).

leads.why: Native 4D generative model with structured spacetime latents built on TRELLIS; MIT code, 36 stars.

leads.name: ShapeGen4D (Snap, 2025-10)
leads.why: 4D shape generation from videos with a pretrained 3D model; precursor of Helix4D.

leads.name: Helix4D (Snap, 2026-05)
leads.why: Video-to-4D mesh generation built on TRELLIS.2, handles topology changes and transparent parts; project page shows only a pipeline figure.

leads.name: Motion 3-to-4 (CVPR 2026)
leads.why: Feed-forward 4D object synthesis from a video plus optional reference mesh; 186 stars; overlaps ActionMesh.

leads.name: Fast 4D Mesh Generation by Spatio-Temporal Attention Chains (NVIDIA, 2026-05)

leads.name: NeuROK: Generative 4D Neural Object Kinematics (Stanford, 2026-05)
leads.why: Learned latent space of physically plausible object deformations; physics-driven 4D, successor line to PhysDreamer.

leads.name: AnimaX (2025-06)
leads.why: Animates rigged 3D meshes with joint video-pose diffusion (299 stars); output is skeletal animation, closer to assets/characters.

leads.name: GenXD (ICLR 2025)
leads.why: Joint 3D/4D scene generation with the CamVid-30K dataset (NUS, Microsoft); overlaps DimensionX.

leads.name: Beyond Pixels / Latent-to-4D (Zhejiang University, 2026-08)
leads.why: Decodes 4D directly from the latents of any video DiT sharing a VAE; 193 Hugging Face upvotes but no demo video yet.

leads.name: TesserAct (UMass Amherst, 2025-04)
leads.why: 4D embodied world model predicting RGB, depth and normals for robot manipulation; belongs to world-models (physical AI).

leads.name: RynnWorld-4D (Alibaba DAMO Academy, 2026-07)
leads.why: RGB, depth and flow world model for robot manipulation; belongs to world-models (physical AI).

leads.name: Kinema4D (NTU, 2026-03)
leads.why: Action-conditioned 4D generative robot simulator; belongs to world-models (physical AI).

leads.why: Evaluation framework for 3D/4D world generation models; candidate for infra/benchmarks.

leads.why: Generative dynamic Gaussian reconstruction from monocular video (NVIDIA and Stanford authors); video model fills unseen regions, then distilled to one 4D Gaussian scene; no project page found yet.

leads.why: Full-scope 4D scene generation from a single-view video; no project page or code found.

leads.why: Panoramic trajectory guidance for synthesising unseen regions of 4D scenes from monocular video; no project page found.

leads.why: Feed-forward video-driven animation of a static mesh via blended latent rigid-motion primitives (arXiv 2608.31113); no project page, video or code found.
